tasks.label: Android: Sandjongg
tasks.detail: Build web bundle, assemble debug APK via Gradle, install + launch on connected device or emulator
tasks.command: set -e; ADB="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/platform-tools/adb"; SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"; echo '[Android] Building web bundle + scaffolding Android project...'; bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts mobile --game=sandjongg --target=android --skip-gradle; echo ''; echo '[Android] Assembling debug APK via Gradle...'; cd games/sandjongg/android; echo "sdk.dir=$SDK" > local.properties; echo '[Android] Stopping stale Gradle daemons...'; timeout 15 ./gradlew --stop </dev/null 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo '[Android] Running gradlew assembleDebug...'; timeout 180 ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon </dev/null 2>&1 | tail -5; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; if [ ! -f "$APK" ]; then echo '[Android] ERROR: APK not found at $APK'; exit 1; fi; echo ''; echo '[Android] Checking for connected devices...'; DEVICES=$(timeout 10 "$ADB" devices 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^List' | grep -v '^$' | grep 'device$' | head -1); if [ -z "$DEVICES" ]; then echo '[Android] No device connected. Starting emulator...'; EMU_BIN="$SDK/emulator/emulator"; AVD_NAME=$(timeout 10 "$EMU_BIN" -list-avds 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$AVD_NAME" ]; then echo '[Android] No AVD found. Create one via Android Studio or:'; echo '  avdmanager create avd -n downdraft -k "system-images;android-36;google_apis;x86_64" -d pixel_7'; exit 1; fi; echo "[Android] Starting emulator: $AVD_NAME"; ("$EMU_BIN" -avd "$AVD_NAME" -gpu host -no-snapshot -no-audio -no-boot-anim > /tmp/emulator.log 2>&1 &); echo '[Android] Waiting for emulator to boot (120s timeout)...'; timeout 120 bash -c "\"$ADB\" wait-for-device && for i in \$(seq 1 60); do BOOT=\$(\"$ADB\" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\\r'); [ \"\$BOOT\" = \"1\" ] && break; sleep 2; done" || { echo '[Android] ERROR: Emulator failed to boot within 120s. Check /tmp/emulator.log.'; exit 1; }; echo '[Android] Emulator booted.'; fi; echo ''; echo '[Android] Installing APK...'; timeout 60 "$ADB" install -r "$APK" 2>&1; echo ''; echo '[Android] Enabling SharedArrayBuffer + WebGPU flags...'; timeout 10 "$ADB" shell "echo 'webview --enable-features=SharedArrayBuffer,UnsafeWebGPU --ignore-gpu-blocklist' > /data/local/tmp/webview-command-line" 2>/dev/null || echo '[Android] WARN: Could not set WebView flags (device may not be writable)'; echo ''; echo '[Android] Launching app...'; timeout 10 "$ADB" shell am force-stop com.downdraft.sandjongg 2>/dev/null; timeout 10 "$ADB" logcat -c 2>/dev/null; timeout 10 "$ADB" shell am start -n com.downdraft.sandjongg/com.downdraft.shell.MainActivity 2>&1; echo ''; echo '[Android] App launched. Waiting 8s for boot...'; sleep 8; echo '[Android] Boot logs:'; timeout 10 "$ADB" logcat -d 2>&1 | grep -iE 'DowndraftShell|Capacitor/Console|webgpu|guard|mobile.*ready|mobile.*Fatal|No GPU adapter' | head -15; echo ''; if timeout 10 "$ADB" logcat -d 2>&1 | grep -q 'No GPU adapter found'; then echo '[Android] WARNING: WebGPU adapter not available on this device/emulator.'; echo '[Android] The game UI will render but the WebGPU canvas will be blank.'; echo '[Android] The Android emulator does not support WebGPU — use a physical device for rendering.'; echo '[Android] See README.md > "WebGPU on the Android emulator" for details.'; fi; echo ''; echo '[Android] Done. Follow logs with: adb logcat | grep -i downdraft'
